title: Shenzhen Launches OpenFit 2 AI Open-Ear Headphones, Upgraded Qianwen Large Model Sold for 1698 Yuan

content_html:
The open-ear headphone market has seen new developments, with Shang音 officially launching the OpenFit2AI open-ear headphones on the Tmall platform. As an upgraded version of the standard models OpenFit2/OpenFit2+, this product focuses on deep integration of AI capabilities, priced at 1698 yuan, and planned to be officially released on August 17th.

In terms of appearance and wearing design, the headphones continue to use the classic split-ear dolphin arc ear hook structure. The ear-fitting part is wrapped with double-layer silicone, featuring Shokz Ultra-Soft Silicone 2.0 ultra-zero silicone material on the inner layer, combined with extremely fine flexible titanium alloy wire embedded inside the ear hook. The official claims that even during intense exercise, the headphones can remain secure and are unlikely to fall off or shift.

Smart experience is the main highlight of this upgrade. OpenFit2AI fully integrates and upgrades support for the Qwen large model, providing users with rich features such as AI summaries, mind map generation, multilingual transcription, and meeting insights. Additionally, each side of the headphones is equipped with an independent storage chip, capable of storing approximately 4GB (a total of 8GB) of on-site recording or call recordings, meeting diverse needs in daily recording and office scenarios.
